findings.highlight: ever since I got to this hill
findings.evidenceJa: 坂道を登り始めてから
findings.governingReading: The arm begins hurting after Shirou starts climbing the slope.
findings.explanation: The English moves the onset from the act of climbing to arrival at the hill.

findings.highlight: Someone else’s arm is attached to me
findings.evidenceJa: 他所の腕を無理やりつけてる
findings.governingReading: Another person’s arm has been forcibly attached to him.
findings.explanation: The English omits the force of the transplant.

findings.highlight: I can’t get my breathing together.
findings.evidenceJa: 呼吸がなかなか整わない
findings.governingReading: His breathing will not readily settle.
findings.explanation: “Get my breathing together” is malformed English.

findings.highlight: When it gets hotter than my normal temperature
findings.evidenceJa: 平熱を大きく逸脱した瞬間
findings.governingReading: The stabbing pain begins the instant the arm greatly departs from normal body temperature.
findings.explanation: The English removes the magnitude and precise threshold.

findings.highlight: pain attacks my chest from my arm
findings.evidenceJa: ズシャ、と肩口から胸に痛みが突き刺さる
findings.governingReading: With a sudden stabbing onset, pain pierces from the shoulder into the chest.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the onset sound and replaces the shoulder-to-chest path with generic arm-to-chest pain.

findings.evidenceJa: 左腕の中で溜まりきって一杯になった時
findings.governingReading: Heat accumulates inside the arm until it is completely full.
findings.explanation: “Overheats” deletes the capacity model governing how excess heat enters his body.

findings.evidenceJa: ライダーに肋を砕かれかけた
findings.explanation: The English changes a near outcome into completed crushing.

findings.highlight: getting stabbed by my own body
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の腕に自分の体が“貫かれる”
findings.governingReading: His own body is “pierced” by his own arm.
findings.explanation: The English makes his body the weapon rather than the arm piercing it.

findings.highlight: You can’t even move the fingers
findings.evidenceJa: 指先だって満足に動かない
findings.governingReading: The fingertips do not move properly or adequately.
findings.explanation: The English turns severe limitation into absolute inability and broadens fingertips to whole fingers.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしに話しても無駄だから
findings.governingReading: Sakura asks whether he stays silent because telling her would be pointless.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the act of telling and Sakura as its recipient.

findings.highlight: don’t tell Sakura about it so she doesn’t get worried?
findings.evidenceJa: なにが桜を不安にさせたくないから黙っていよう、だ
findings.governingReading: Shirou scornfully quotes his own excuse: “What was that about keeping quiet so Sakura would not worry?”
findings.explanation: The English becomes a fresh instruction not to tell Sakura, reversing the retrospective self-rebuke.

findings.governingReading: Shirou says something was managed regarding the arm, despite its severe state.
findings.explanation: “Turned out fine” contradicts the arm’s established immobility and pain.

findings.highlight: I couldn’t save Illya like I’d planned
findings.evidenceJa: 満足にイリヤも助けられなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he could not rescue Illya adequately.
findings.explanation: The English invents deviation from a plan and risks suggesting the rescue itself failed.

findings.highlight: Illya, silently radiating a strange pressure
findings.evidenceJa: 妙な緊迫感で押し黙ったイリヤ
findings.governingReading: Illya stands silent in an oddly tense state.
findings.explanation: The English makes Illya project an intimidating pressure rather than experience tension.

findings.highlight: It’ll be hard work if I want him to become strong in a short time.
findings.evidenceJa: 短期間で戦力になってもらうにはスパルタしかない
findings.governingReading: Rin says Spartan treatment is the only way to make Shirou combat-capable quickly.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the only-option claim and combat readiness, replacing them with generic hard work and strength.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka Rin sets a schedule even I haven’t heard about.
findings.evidenceJa: しれっと、俺ですら聞いた事のないスケジュールを口にする
findings.governingReading: Rin casually and brazenly announces a schedule even Shirou has never heard.
findings.explanation: The English preserves surprise but drops Rin’s unruffled delivery.

findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんと三食付きにして
findings.governingReading: Rin demands that the lodging properly include three meals a day.
findings.explanation: The English omits the concrete three-meal term of her mock debt collection.
